issue: Massachusetts, Illinois and Rhode Island vote counts are partial
detail: The only counts available are aggregator captures taken mid-count: MA 29,800, IL 108,049, RI 77,342. All three are implausible for a statewide electorate.
why_unresolved: Official sources unreachable or not yet published.
recommended_action: Do not use these counts or any margin derived from them. Reload from the state election authority once published.

issue: Alaska and Mississippi have no count anywhere
detail: Both races remain uncalled and no source publishes vote totals.
why_unresolved: The races were not decided at the time of collection.
recommended_action: Leave as Pending. Reload when the states report.

detail: certification_status is 'Not certified' on all 35 races.
why_unresolved: Certification follows each state's canvass, which had not occurred.
recommended_action: Reload after canvass and set certification_status, certified_date and the certified flag.

issue: All 210 race ratings are unverified and quarantined
detail: No rating could be confirmed at its publisher; three are contradicted by a later source.
why_unresolved: All six publishers are unreachable from this environment.
recommended_action: Re-collect ratings and their publication dates from each publisher before any forecast analysis. Until then they stay out of measures.

detail: No county or state demographic table ships in this version.
why_unresolved: The Census API requires a key that cannot be obtained here.
recommended_action: Run the supplied refresh script with a free Census key. It also builds the county FIPS dimension.

detail: Only 108 of 619 filers report through 2026-10-14; 286 state no period at all.
why_unresolved: A property of the FEC source, not an error.
recommended_action: Filter on comparability_cohort before comparing money between candidates.

issue: Committee IDs collected only for ballot candidates
detail: 70 of 72 ballot candidates have a principal committee ID; the other 549 filers do not.
why_unresolved: The remaining filers are outside the analytical set.
recommended_action: Run the refresh script against the FEC candidate master to fill the rest if needed.

issue: Sherrod Brown's committee was converted to a PAC
detail: The FEC notes 2025-2026 activity appears under DIGNITY OF WORK PAC (C00264697), which is not an authorized committee. Candidate-level receipts may understate money associated with this candidate.
why_unresolved: A real feature of the filer's structure.
recommended_action: Note it on any money chart that includes Ohio. Do not add PAC money to candidate totals.

issue: Montana's official page carries a 'TEST' marker
detail: The Montana results page shows the word TEST in its header alongside otherwise plausible results that reconcile exactly.
recommended_action: Re-verify Montana against the Secretary of State before publishing its figures.

issue: Montana, Nebraska and West Virginia counts are incomplete
detail: Reporting units: MT 623 of 728 precincts fully, NE 99.02%, WV 52 of 55 counties.
recommended_action: margin_safe_to_use is N for these. Reload before using margins.

issue: 29 ballot candidates have no FEC candidate ID
detail: All are write-in or minor-party candidates with no filing found in their state.
why_unresolved: FEC filing is only required above the $5,000 threshold, so most genuinely never filed.
recommended_action: Leave blank. Confirm against the FEC candidate master on refresh.

issue: Texas's older official results system still serves 2024 by default
detail: results.texas-election.com opens on the 2024 general election. Its 2024 Senate figures would silently pass as current.
recommended_action: Use the current system at goelect.txelections.civixapps.com and always confirm the election name shown on the page.
